Kitchen Rewires in Horsham and Cuckfield

Recent kitchen rewires include Redford Avenue and The Hornets in Horsham and Leyton Lea in Cuckfield. The photos show a new kitchen with a pendant going up over the island, the pantry next door finished with downlights over the worktops, and an open plan kitchen and living room finished with downlights.

Planned Round the Kitchen

Scott's short answer to what goes wrong with kitchen rewires is poor planning. So the sockets, appliance circuits and lights are planned with the kitchen layout before the walls are closed up.

Larger Homes and Conversions

In a high end home the electrics have to disappear: no visible trunking, tidy cable runs and work that suits the design of the house. A Checkatrade customer in TN11 had us do the electrical installation of their barn conversion and asked us back to add more sockets. Ashton had various electrical upgrades and mentions the attention to detail and the ideas that saved money.

Signs It Needs Looking At

These are general signs, not a diagnosis. If you spot one, give us a call and we'll talk it through.

  • A new kitchen layout that needs sockets where the old ones were not
  • Appliances that trip the power when used together
  • An extension or conversion on the way
  • Old wiring found when the old kitchen comes out

Useful to Tell Us

  • The kitchen plan, if your fitter has one
  • Which appliances are going in
  • When the kitchen fitter starts, so we can fit round them
